_comment: Phase 9 Recovery Item 16A. Final orphan edge audit and root-cause classification. Inventory only; not an allow-list and does not weaken tools/audit_node_system.py --ci.
_provenance: Phase 9 Recovery Item 16A; base 3c6b5b1732c2bafaa30cfaa0702a951e3fd857c8 | Item 16B removed only the numeric RC-01 edges it resolved. | Item 17 restored boss combat state progression and remeasured. | Item 18 restored the boss damage pipeline and remeasured.

delta_vs_previous_known_state.reason: PRE-16A added scene bindings only; normalized .zlogic graph baseline remains 50 unique orphan keys. This fixture additionally records 82 edge-side occurrences.

root_causes.description: VictoryLogic is 100% phantom and uses a foreign exec/value UI/project API recorded by Item 14B.
math.divide is the one missing math.* sibling while divide_number exists and accepts a,b -> value.
Node is declared in plugin/optional layer, not in the core catalogue.
Node id is phantom in normalized shipping graph and Item 14B kept it H_UNKNOWN.
Current if_else contract does not declare value/compare_value; assets use stale condition-style data ports.
Current get_position contract differs from EnemyAttackLogic authored ports.
Sequence node does not declare then_N as inputs under current contract.
PlayerCombatLogic wires ports not declared by current contracts.
